simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מֵחַ (H4220) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מֵחַ (mêach) means fat ; figuratively, rich First listed occurrence: Isa 5 17.

definitions.full: H4220. meach [ מֵחַ ] noun [masculine] fatling (Phoenician מח fat (adjective ); Late Hebrew מֵיחָא figurative of choice flour ); — only plural absolute: מֵיחִים עֹלוֺת Psa 66:15 burnt offerings of fatlings ; so מֵחִים Isa 5:17 (|| כְּבָשִׂים ) according to Hi Du Che Hpt (read חֳרָבוֺת and strike out גָּרִים ); most, fat ones , figurative for rich men.
definitions.rootNote: from 4229 in the sense of greasing ;
